## A SECOND symptom on the same side of the same boundary — PR **body writes** also fail, ⛔ relayed not re-measured

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024), session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c` — **2026-09-13T09:11Z**. Adding a reading, ⛔ not a diagnosis.

A dev working PR **#17979** reports, in its delivery record:

> `PATCH` on `https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/17979` returns **HTTP 500** for every payload tried, **including an idempotent title-only one**, via the MCP wrapper and direct REST alike. **GET is 200 and comment POSTs succeed.**

⚠️ **Relayed, ⛔ not re-measured by this seat** — verifying it means issuing a write against someone's open PR purely to probe, which this seat will not do. Treat it as testimony with a named source, exactly as triage treated this card's sibling readings.

### Why it belongs on this card

⭐ The two symptoms sit on **the same side of the same boundary and share a shape**:

| symptom | path | first seen |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `Check PR Size` + `Auto Label` fail | `POST`/`DELETE` **labels** on a PR | 08:50:49Z |
| PR body/title `PATCH` answers 500 | `PATCH` **the pull request** | while #17979 was being delivered, after 09:00Z |

⇒ Both are **write paths against pull requests**; both began after ~08:38Z; and **reads are unaffected** in both cases (`GET` 200, comment `POST` fine, and this seat's own REST headroom read **15,000 / 15,000** at 08:44Z, so ⛔ it is not a rate limit).

⇒ That widens the symptom from "two label jobs" to **"PR write paths"**, and it is evidence the cause is **platform-side rather than repo-side** — consistent with the card's measurement that ⛔ no commit explains it (zero commits on `main` since 08:30Z; `pr-labels.mjs` and `pr-automation.yml` untouched since 08:00Z).

⚠️ ⛔ **Still not a diagnosis.** The failing job's step has not been read by anyone in this session (`/actions/jobs/{id}` and the log download are both unreachable from here), and a 500 is the server declining to say why. A shared cause is now the **more economical** hypothesis, ⛔ not an established one — two symptoms with one plausible common cause is still two symptoms.

### What this changes for whoever picks the card up

- ⛔ Do not start by reading `scripts/pr-labels.mjs`. If PR body `PATCH` is also 500, the script is unlikely to be the subject.
- ⭐ The cheapest decisive test is **time, not code**: re-run one failing label job now and see whether it is still red. If it is green, the window closed and the whole thing was an upstream incident; if it is still red, the boundary is real and persistent. ⚠️ That re-run is a deliberate act on someone else's PR — ⛔ this seat is handed over and will not take it.
- A PR whose body cannot be edited is a real cost to an agent workflow: #17979's dev had to put post-hoc readings in a **comment** instead of the body, and it verified the body was intact after each failed write rather than "repairing" a body that was never damaged. ⇒ Worth recording so the next actor recognises the shape instead of fixing a non-problem.
